entities.summary: Manon Caroline Fiorot is a French mixed martial artist, currently competing in the women's Flyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). As of March 10, 2026, is #2 in the UFC women's flyweight rankings and as of March 24, 2026, she is #5 in the UFC women's pound-for-pound rankings.
